en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on athletes
Watch a documentary on assassins

...You want to understand Gonta more,
is that it?

I'm not looking down on your choice, but
do I have to watch it with you?
It's fine, I'm not exactly against it...

But we're going to watch this till the end,
even if it shows something creepy.
I don't like quitting halfway.

I don't mind watching. I'm impressed with
how athletes train their bodies.

Maybe if I watch how they throw their
javelins, it could help me with <CLT=cltSTRONG>work<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Did you know you need a certain skill to throw
a long pole-like weapon in a straight line?

...Wait. Why am I talking about this?
You don't need to know this.

<CLT=cltMIND>It was a sight for sore eyes, watching
Maki get genuinely excited about something.

<CLT=cltMIND>Of course, if the subject were more
peaceful, that would have been better...
...Huh?

There's no way I would want to watch
something so sick.
...Do you want to die?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Maki looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Maki's inner thoughts...?
